newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-LUPESCU TO MISS ROMANIA'S WORLD CUP MATCH AGAINST ICELAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LUPESCU TO MISS ROMANIA'S WORLD CUP MATCH AGAINST ICELAND.

text.p: Midfielder Ionut Lupescu will miss Romania's World Cup European group eight qualifier against Iceland in Reykjavik next Wednesday because of a fractured foot.
Lupescu, who plays for Germany's Borussia Moenchengladbach, will be sidelined for at least six weeks.
Romania trainer Anghel Iordanescu on Thursday replaced Lupescu with Corneliu Papura. He plays for for French club Rennes.
Defenders - Dan Petrescu, Daniel Prodan, Tiberiu Curt, Corneliu Papura, Anton Dobos, Tibor Selymess, Iulian Filipescu
Midfielders - Ovidiu Sabau, Gheorghe Popescu, Costel Galca, Gheorghe Hagi, Dorinel Munteanu, Ilie Dumitrescu
Forwards - Adrian Ilie, Viorel Moldovan, Ioan Vladoiu, Radu Niculescu
